notes.title: New World Update
notes.notes:
Underworld Overseer Free Content Update!

We are thrilled to announce the release of a new free update for Underworld Overseer! This massive update brings a wealth of exciting new content to keep you on your toes.

Explore a New Island

This update introduces an entire new island featuring 5 brand-new levels, each with its own hardcore version. Get ready to dive into fresh challenges and test your strategic skills.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973861/17d3120846f5414075b00144da885d52c27a3188.png


Survival Challenge

The final level is a special survival mode where you must adapt and endure for a full hour against all the enemies in the game. This intense challenge will push your abilities to the limit.

New Enemies to Ruin Your Plans

This update also introduces a variety of new enemies, each with unique abilities that will test your defenses:

- Treasure Hunters: These cunning pirates will dig towards your treasure rooms and steal your gold. Protect your riches at all costs!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973861/2a19f28b90d9cd16fa959478a1d06127a693ae4a.png

- Demolitionists: These unfortunate prisoners, with barrels of explosives strapped to them, are sent to your dungeon by other humans. Their explosive power can create big holes in your defenses. Can you turn their destructive force to your advantage?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973861/1243288797cea93a8bcae206b4b0fd03970e9327.png

- Shield Bearers: Equipped with massive shields, these warriors will protect their allies from your crossbows, allowing them to reach your dungeon. Strategize carefully to overcome their defenses.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973861/dc2b76eaff3f1ae49726314c0c9aa96072f1d09b.png

- Carpenters: These skilled builders will construct bridges to help invaders reach your dungeon. Prevent their progress to keep your stronghold secure.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973861/c657404426c48d63ab64c4758c41468e05a5334e.png

- Priestess: Beware the priestess, who can turn your skeletons against you. Do not underestimate her power!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973861/98f10a41589139cfd00decef4d26b199a71c498b.png


Get ready to face these new challenges and enemies in the latest free update for Underworld Overseer. We can't wait to see how you fare against these formidable foes!

Stay tuned for more updates and exciting content. Happy gaming!

Myron

notes.title: Patch note for build 264
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue preventing the next wave to be spawned if the game was saved and quitted before the first wave.
- Tweaked Necromancy hard balacing.
- Units will get more happiness back when they eat or sleep or get money.
- Fixed an error causing the restart level button to not be present when it should

notes.title: Update 1 is now live
notes.notes:
Underworld Overseer Update 1
version 254

Thank you all for playing Underworld Overseer. We are a very small team and your support means a lot to us. We worked hard to fix reported issues and improve balancing based on your feedback.

Improvements

 The plague doctor is now healing his wounded allies
 The plague doctor is now dropping a bottle when he dies
 Improved the alarm trap sound and visual to make it more noticeable for the player
 Mandrakes are now animated to make the farm more alive
 Added a vfx when you eat one of your units
 Improved the back of the mountain texture
 Improved tooltips to reduce confusion about cost and stock of needed resources
 Grabbing a unit reset his work cooldown so the player can encourage them to work if he drops them near an availabe work
 Starved and sleepy units will now try to fulfill their need as soon as possible and not only the next time the need it
 Improved the mana pool animations
 The dungeon’s walls are now reinforced and a bit longer to be digged by sappers than normal walls


Balancing

 Reduced toxic golem explosion damage
 Increased bubblegum golem explosion damage
 Remade the necromancy hard level so it can be completed by playing the normal way as it was confusing for many players
 Increased the slow effect duration from 5s to 8s
 Slightly increased bone fairies attack range


Bug fixes

 The plague doctor is now properly immune to toxic golem explosions
 Fixed a bug causing the poison clouds damage to be dealed even when the enemy left the cloud
 Fixed a bug preventing the final level to be finished after loading a save done when no blue cultist were alive
 The health of the dungeon heart is now loaded properly and not reset to max health when loading a saved game
 Tweaked the collider so it is easier to eat units
 Fix an issue causing some sounds to be played twice when using the rally and raid spells
 Fix many vfx not played properly when too many of them need to be played at the same time
 Ethereal imps are now properly immune to the Goddess explosion
 The first mandrake spell is no longer spawning 2 mandrake per enemy instead of 1
 Fixed an issue preventing the units to eat some mandrakes spawned in the farm because they were not added in the list properly making them complain about the lack of food for no reason
 Priest’s shield audio loop is now properly muted when the shield is disabled by the anti magic trap


What's next?
We are currently working on a bigger update that we want to release in the end of January. This new update will include 5 new levels as well as new game changer enemies. 

Stay tuned and thank you for your support!

PS : Please consider writing a small review about the game. It helps us a lot!
